_**User**_

You are integrating and verifying Clean Sheet at /Volumes/MacExt/CleanSheet. Two other agents already wrote the Vite + React + TypeScript app. Do not rebuild it from scratch. Do not git commit. Do not touch .specstory.

Goal: prove the app builds and the full user workflow works in the browser. Fix only real integration or behavior bugs you find. Keep the existing visual design.

## What already exists

Engine (src/lib): parseCsv, analyze, applyClean(rows, width, mode), toCsv, downloadCsv, cleanDownloadName, SAMPLE_NAME, SAMPLE_CSV. `npm run check` already printed csv.check ok. Sample has 18 data rows. Mode "all" drops incomplete rows first, then duplicates. Row indexes in Analysis are 0-based data rows.

UI: src/App.tsx, src/index.css, src/components/* (BarSheet, Dock, UploadBar, PreviewBar, Workspace, format, rows, types). Dark desk, paper preview sheet, bottom dock with Upload and Preview pop-up bars. main.tsx imports ./App (default export) and ./index.css. Dev server port 5173.

## Steps

1. Read the key files enough to know the real controls and labels (App.tsx, Workspace, UploadBar, PreviewBar, csv.ts exports). Do not restyle.

2. Run `npm run check` and `npm run build` from /Volumes/MacExt/CleanSheet. If tsc or vite fails, fix the cause. Do not weaken strict TypeScript to hide errors.

3. Start `npm run dev` (port 5173, or the next free port if 5173 is taken). Note the actual URL.

4. Verify in the browser with the cursor-ide-browser tools (GetDynamicTools first for that namespace). Exercise the real UI, not just a screenshot:
   - Open the app. Upload bar should start open.
   - Load the sample. Preview should open. Confirm row count, duplicate highlighting, and blank cells (the word "blank").
   - Use the Issues filter, then return to All.
   - Click Clean sheet. Status should report removed incomplete rows and duplicates, and remaining rows. Expected from the authors: 5 incomplete, 3 duplicates, 10 remain. If the live numbers differ, trust the engine and the on-screen result; only fix the app if the clean action does not actually remove duplicate rows and rows with missing values, or the status is wrong relative to the data.
   - Restore original, confirm the issues come back.
   - Download CSV. Confirm a download is triggered (browser download event, or the anchor click / blob). Filename should be harbor-orders-clean.csv when the sample is loaded and has been cleaned or even before clean — download exports the current working rows.
   - Close a bar with Escape and with the backdrop.
   - Upload a tiny invalid file if you can construct one in the page (or skip if file input cannot be set). At minimum, confirm the Choose CSV control exists.
   - Check a narrow viewport (~390px) only enough to see the dock and primary actions are usable, then return to desktop.

5. If you find a bug, fix it and re-check that path. Do not add features.

6. Stop the dev server when finished if you started it.

Return a short report: build result, URL you tested, what you clicked and what you observed (row counts before/after clean, download filename, bar close), bugs fixed (file + what changed), and anything you could not verify.

The download anchor is created and clicked synchronously during the button handler. A capturing click listener must be installed before the button is clicked to intercept it.

Monkeypatching HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click to capture the download filename and href before the browser handles it. After clicking Download CSV, I will verify the blob contains 18 data rows plus the header.

The monkeypatched click handler risks losing the blob URL before it can be fetched. revokeObjectURL runs in a setTimeout 0, so the URL is revoked after the current stack finishes. I need to capture the blob content synchronously inside the override before the original click returns.

I will monkeypatch URL.createObjectURL to store blob references in a global array. After the download click, I can read the blob content with FileReader even if the object URL is revoked, because the blob itself remains accessible.
